description:
Join a Top-Rated Tech Company in Big Data!

Smart Apartment Data, a five-star employee-rated company and Best & Brightest Companies to Work For winner, is on the cutting edge of Big Data in real estate. We offer a fun, collaborative environment, generous pay with bonuses, and a strong work-life balance.

About Us: For 19 years, we’ve been the market leading in big data analytics for U.S. —empowering brokers, investors, and analysts with real-time market intelligence.

About You: We are looking for someone fluent in English with the ability to express their creativity and talents for a full-time position. You will work on interesting projects with experienced developers using the AWS cloud.

Sneak peek of projects:

  • Big Data Analytics
  • AI driven data modelling
  • Spatial map & sophisticated reporting

  • Fluent in English
  • Ability to work flexible hours
  • 3+ years of hands-on experience as an Angular Frontend Developer
  • Strong understanding of front-end and enterprise app design

We Offer:

  • Location Independent / 100% Remote
  • Competitive salary
  • Work with latest and cutting-edge technologies
  • Training and mentoring by senior developers
